name: Lost Tower
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

show.places_note: Seven floors, each a region of the one grid (docs/lost-tower-port.md).

music.note: MUSIC_LOSTTOWER_A in its hall (SceneManager.cpp:1047-1073; the user, 2026-10-05).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

boids.note: MODEL_BAT01 (GOBoid.cpp:1327-1328): the bird's 1.0, its light and its 0.5 (GOBoid.cpp:1316-1320), SOUND_BAT01 alone. The cook spaces its four keys 0.25 s apart, so 6.25 for MU's key a frame at 0.04 s.

skulls.note: The skulls and chips he kicks (game/world/skulls.h).
